facts: Elizabeth Holmes spoke at The Journal's WSJDLive event on Wednesday, October 22, 2015.
Holmes stated that Theranos has not used the technology referred to as Edison for a few years.
According to Holmes, Theranos has never used commercially available lab equipment for finger-stick based tests.
Theranos operates in California, Pennsylvania, and Arizona.
Holmes stated that Google Ventures reached out to Theranos, and Theranos declined to meet with them.
Holmes addressed criticism regarding blood sample dilution and reporting from The Wall Street Journal.
